citation.title: Fast topology optimization of phononic crystal-based metastructures for vibration isolation by deep learning
citation.authors: Chen-Xu Liu, Gui-Lan Yu, Zhanli Liu

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract says the deep-learning optimization reaches comparable or better designs than a genetic algorithm using one ten-thousandth of its time.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Abstract states ML uses 0.01% of GA time, so 100/0.01 = 10,000 [inferred].

baseline.quality_gap: Similar or better results than GA (abstract)

notes: Publisher abstract was accessible, but the full-text link resolved to the abstract page and a direct full-text request returned HTTP 403. The abstract says data and code are shared, but their location and runnable status could not be checked.
